title: GET /api/v1/token: result
description: The calling token itself, never its hash and only the prefix of its secret.

level.description: Code. What the token may do: read, block or write; each level reaches the ones below it.

clusters.description: Value. The clusters the token is limited to; empty means all.

objects.description: Value. The objects a block token is limited to; empty means all.

sources.description: Value. The addresses or networks the token may be used from; empty means anywhere.

prefix.description: Value. The first characters of the secret, to tell tokens apart.

created_at.description: Value. When the token was made.

expires_at.description: Value. When the token stops working.
